intents.dispute: "This is not mine" or "it was closed years ago".
intents.human: A member who asks for a person.

lines.opening: Hello, this is the automated assistant of Harbourline Credit Union.
lines.robot: Yes, I am an automated assistant calling on behalf of Harbourline Credit Union.
lines.scam: I understand your caution. I will never ask for your PIN or your full card number, and you can call Harbourline Credit Union back on the number on our website.
lines.purpose_before_verify: I can only share the reason for my call with {title} {last_name}, after a short security check.
lines.no_info: I'm sorry, I can't share that information.
lines.not_talk_once: I understand, this will only take a few minutes.
lines.tp_ask: When would be a good time to reach {title} {last_name}?
lines.tp_outside_window: I'm sorry, we can only call back between 10:00 and 19:00, today or on the next business day. Which time would suit?
lines.tp_no_info: I'm sorry, I can only discuss this with {title} {last_name} personally.
lines.tp_booked: Thank you, we will call back on {date} at {time}.
lines.wrong_number: I'm sorry for the trouble, we will update our details.
lines.condolence: I'm very sorry for your loss. Thank you for letting us know.
lines.id_intro: Before we continue, I need to ask you two security questions.
lines.id_why: These questions protect your personal information.
lines.id_explain: I can only tell you why I'm calling once I have checked that I'm speaking with the right person.
lines.id_declined: I understand. Without these answers I can't continue this call.
lines.id_repeat: Sorry, could you repeat that, please?
lines.id_wrong: I'm sorry, that doesn't match the details we have.
lines.id_failed: I'm sorry, I couldn't verify your identity, so I can't continue this call. Please contact Harbourline Credit Union directly.
lines.disclose_intro: Thank you. I'm calling about late payments on your account with us.
lines.product_line: Your {name} is {days} days late, with {amount} past due.
lines.ask_today: Can you pay the full past-due amount of {amount} today?
lines.ask_today_multi: Can you pay the full past-due amounts today?
lines.offer_floor_date: I understand. Could you pay {amount} on {date}?
lines.below_floor: I'm sorry, the lowest amount I can accept is {floor}.
lines.below_floor_again: I'm sorry, that is still below the lowest amount I can accept.
lines.date_past: That date has already passed. Which date would work for you?
lines.not_business_day: That day is not a business day. The next business day is {date}. Would that work for you?
lines.after_deadline: I'm sorry, the latest date I can accept is {date}. Could you pay by then?
lines.vague_ask: Which exact day would you pay?
lines.ask_date_for_amount: On which date could you pay {amount}?
lines.repeat_offer: To repeat, could you pay {amount} on {date}?
lines.readback_intro: Let me read back what we agreed.
lines.clamped_note: For your {name}, the latest possible date is {deadline}, so that payment is on {date}.
lines.confirm_again: Sorry, I did not catch that. Do you confirm, yes or no?
lines.recorded: Thank you, your promise has been recorded.
lines.record_failed: I'm sorry, the promise could not be recorded because of a system problem.
lines.paid_line: Thank you. Payments can take one business day to appear.
lines.dispute_line: I understand, I won't go into it further. Our team will look into it.
lines.hardship: I'm very sorry to hear that. Would you like me to transfer you to our member care team?
lines.hardship_declined: I understand. Thank you for telling me.
lines.restructure_line: I'll transfer you to our restructuring team, who can talk about a payment plan with you.
lines.human_ask_help: Is there anything I can help you with myself?
lines.transfer: I'm transferring you now. Please hold.
lines.anything_else: Is there anything else I can help you with?
lines.promise_change: I'm sorry, I can't change that promise on this call.
lines.goodbye: Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
lines.below_floor_final: I'm sorry, I can't accept less than {amount}.
lines.callback_failed: I'm sorry, I couldn't book the callback.
lines.transfer_failed: I'm sorry, the transfer did not go through.
lines.system_error: I'm sorry, our system is not responding right now.

rules.opening_blocks_repeat.derivation: The opening ask is not a proposal/attempt, so it does not block a ladder step with the same amount and date; default false.

rules.skipped_repeat_counts.assumption: The brief does not say whether a skipped repeat step uses an attempt; engine default applies.

rules.too_much_floor.assumption: Brief silent on 'the full amount is too much'; default attempt_1 (floor offered next as an attempt).

rules.ladder_repeat_last.assumption: Brief lists exactly two steps for two attempts; no repetition.

quotes: Each flat refusal uses one
rules.non_answer_counts.derivation: Only flat refusals use an attempt; a non-answer does not.

quotes: If the member flatly refuses, make the persuasion attempts of the product's band, in this order:
2. the floor on the deadline.
rules.refuse_deadline_is_refusal.derivation: Refusing a proposal on the deadline is a flat refusal of that attempt.

quotes: The floor is the lowest amount that may be accepted for one product: `minimum_payment` for a credit card and
`instalment_amount` for a personal loan, in both bands.
products.floor_pct.derivation: The floor is an account field, not a percentage.

products.floor_full_below.assumption: No threshold below which the full amount is the floor.

products.floor_round.assumption: Floors are taken from account fields; no rounding stated.

products.step_round.assumption: No percentage steps; no rounding stated.

products.promise_round.assumption: No rounding rule for promises; amount sent as stated.

quotes: From 2 November 2026 (calls on that day included), for
the 5th business day after today instead of the 10th. Personal loans in the early band keep the 10th business
Calls before 2 November 2026 use section 2.4 as written.
changes.derivation: From 2026-11-02 the early band (bands.0) gets a credit_card-specific deadline of the 5th business day after today; personal loans and the late band unchanged.

assumptions: Rhea Okonkwo's email of 14 October 2026 is withdrawn in full by the memo of 21 October 2026 and never took effect: late-band personal loans keep instalment_amount as floor, 2026-12-24 is a normal business day (not a holiday), restructuring transfers go to the 'restructuring' queue.

Amendment AM-2 applies from 2026-11-02 (calls that day included) only to credit cards in the early band: deadline becomes the 5th business day after today; modelled in 'changes' as bands.0.deadline_by_type.credit_card.

Late band roll: 'if today is the last business day of the month, the deadline is the last business day of the following month' is modelled with roll_if_not_after_today (also rolls if the month's last business day is already past, e.g. on a weekend call after it).
Step dates after the product's deadline use the deadline (built-in behaviour).
The brief says nothing about callbacks when someone else answers; defaults used (today or next business day, 10:00-19:00, later than now, 2 asks).
The brief gives no code for an unclear identity confirmation; it is closed as not_reached / no_callback.
Confirmation question asked up to 2 times (default); 'next <weekday>' read as the following calendar week (default).
No rule for days_late outside 1-90; such a product gets no offer and ends with the default service_error handling.
The brief does not say how often an unclear answer is repeated; max_unclear left to the engine default.
Asking what the call is about instead of answering a security question counts as declining (default).
No SMS or other sentence required after a recorded promise; sms_line is empty.
The brief says nothing about changing a recorded promise; the agent says it cannot be changed on this call.
Weekend-call policy is not stated; deadlines and steps are computed as usual.
